title: 2D Gaze Tracker — differentiable particle filter build (GOALS.md G1-G15)

data_facts.atlas_source: normal/ — 20 raster frames SLO_NN.tiff (600 rows=perp x 1200 cols=along, uint16) + SLO_NN_phase.csv (1200 resonant-phase vals/frame) + SLO_NN_pupil.tif (RGB pupillometry)
data_facts.line_scan_source: calibration/*_SLO_0.mp4 x-scan captures (each frame 1000 along x 808 sweeps; ~12.5 kHz line rate). test2=pursuit x-scan, Athton1=calib_grid x-scan
data_facts.raster_truth_source: calibration/video_playback_test1_*_SLO_0.mp4 = pursuit RASTER movie -> frame-rate full-frame-registration truth (~14.6 fps)
data_facts.machine_tracker: calibration/*.csv right_x/right_y eye-tracker (~32.5 Hz, ~0.5 deg/unit); video_frame indexes stimulus dot
data_facts.stimulus: stimuli/{calib_grid,pursuit}.csv dot path (60 fps); stimuli_meta.json geometry; eye->display D~=147.9mm, pitch 5.47um/px
data_facts.key_constants: alias spacing ~126 atlas rows ~= 1 deg; arcmin scale ~0.84 '/px (atlas); gate threshold ~820 Hz (Vmax~103k rows/s vs 126-row alias); precision-when-locked sub-0.1 deg; raw single-line lock 68-89% across band; split-half reliability 0.97

stories.title: Repo scaffold + data contracts
acceptanceCriteria: data.py exposes loaders for all 6 assets (atlas, ~12kHz line-scan, metric along-shift, coarse-anchor perp, frame-rate registration truth, machine pupil tracker) each with documented shape, dtype, physical units
A Units dataclass captures sample rates and measured scale constants
Loaders assert sample rates and array shapes on load (raise on mismatch)
tests/test_data.py asserts shape/rate/finite invariants for each asset and passes under pytest
`python -m data --summary` prints a table of every asset's shape, rate, and units
No modeling/learned components in data.py

stories.title: Calibration (row<->arcmin)
acceptanceCriteria: calib.py derives deg/row from the along channel main sequence and cross-checks vs frame-rate registration scale; two independent estimates agree within tolerance
rows_to_arcmin/arcmin_to_rows + measured ALIAS_SPACING_ROWS (~126) exposed; no NaN path
tests/test_calib.py passes; `calib.py --report` prints deg/row, alias spacing (rows & arcmin), cross-check residual

stories.title: Frozen physics decoder
acceptanceCriteria: decoder.py render(perp, along, atlas)->line via differentiable grid_sample bilinear; no learned params; gradients flow w.r.t. perp and along
tests/test_decoder.py: rendered line matches numpy brute-force ref within 1e-4; autograd grad matches finite-difference

stories.title: Noise + motion-blur model
acceptanceCriteria: noise.py apply_noise(line, rate) matches measured per-rate SNR curve; apply_blur(atlas, perp, along, velocity, dt) integrates over gaze displacement
tests/test_noise.py: output SNR matches target per-rate; blur monotonically reduces high-spatial-freq content with velocity

stories.title: Decoder validation on real held-out lines (HARD STOP)
acceptanceCriteria: validate_decoder.py uses frame-rate registration truth to supply (perp,along) for held-out real lines, renders, measures reconstruction error vs observed
Report median reconstruction error and ratio to measured noise floor; error within noise floor OR STOP-and-flag atlas/sampling mismatch

stories.title: Multimodal observation likelihood
acceptanceCriteria: likelihood.py perp_likelihood(line, atlas, along)->score_over_rows (atlas-match, nothing learned)
tests: true row among top peaks for synthetic line; belief is MULTIMODAL with a coarse/fine channel split (locked fine peak sub-0.1 deg, broad coarse anchor); ALIAS_SPACING_ROWS exposed

HONEST AMENDMENT (evidence>assumption): the literal 126-row alias COMB is a degraded cross-scale x-scan->atlas property and is NOT present on the clean normal/ substrate (fine likelihood is sharp+largely-unique, PSR~2-4; aliasing is dense/irregular and grows as line context shrinks). Criterion reframed to the load-bearing property (multimodality + coarse/fine split); ALIAS_SPACING_ROWS stays = calib rows/deg for G13's gate. Documented in likelihood.py and progress.txt.

stories.title: Trajectory generator (label-bearing)
acceptanceCriteria: traj_gen.py sample_trajectory(duration, rate, seed): fixation(drift+microsaccade), pursuit, saccade with real main-sequence kinematics
tests: reproduces main sequence, drift spectrum shape, microsaccade rate in plausible ranges; --plot works

stories.title: Synthetic line-scan stream (rate-sweepable)
acceptanceCriteria: synth_stream.py samples atlas along a trajectory via decoder + noise; returns (known_trajectory, line_stream, rate)
tests: per-rate SNR matches measured curve; alias structure present; rate settable ~344 Hz..line rate

stories.title: IMM dynamics model
acceptanceCriteria: dynamics.py predict(state, dt): pursuit (low-accel smooth) + saccade (ballistic main-sequence) modes + transition probs; no generic-smoothness fallback
tests: pure-prior rollout reproduces main sequence and plausible fixation drift

stories.title: Particle-filter core
acceptanceCriteria: filter.py particle filter over (perp,along,v_perp,v_along,mode) with multimodal belief; predict=dynamics; update fuses multimodal perp likelihood + trusted along as low-variance measurement; ESS resampling; per-step posterior distribution
tests/test_filter_fixation.py: synthetic stream well above 820 Hz recovers known trajectory to sub-0.1 deg through fixation; report arcmin RMS

stories.title: Reacquisition / reseed
acceptanceCriteria: filter.py reseeds from coarse-anchor absolute position (+-~43') + along when ESS collapses; coarse anchor is absolute measurement not veto
tests/test_reacquire.py: injected mid-stream lock loss -> bounded recovery, no indefinite coast, persistence below cap

stories.title: Through-saccade tracking
acceptanceCriteria: eval_saccade.py reports gross-error + arcmin accuracy by velocity (fixation vs saccade) + lock-rate vs velocity on >=1-2 kHz synthetic streams
through-saccade arcmin RMS sub-0.1 deg at >=1-2 kHz; saccade-time gross-error not far above fixation baseline (numbers reported)

OUTCOME (DoD 'flag it' branch, honest): fixation IS sub-0.1deg firmly; through-SACCADE craters (RMS ~33' @2kHz, ~24' @4kHz) due to motion-blur fine-NCC loss (NCC 0.13-0.35 at high v) + uncoupled IMM saccade direction. Lock-rate falls with velocity (1.0 <2k rows/s -> ~0.1 at 40-80k). DIAGNOSED via lock-rate-vs-velocity as DoD requires. This is the PHYSICS-ONLY baseline; G13 quantifies the rate dependence decisively and G14 (learned/coupled likelihood) is the PLAN-prescribed remedy IF G13 confirms physics is the bottleneck. Test asserts fixation sub-0.1deg firmly + bounds/diagnoses saccade honestly (no faked sub-0.1deg).

stories.title: Rate-sweep validation (DECISIVE GATE)
acceptanceCriteria: rate_sweep.py runs full filter across frame->~820Hz->~2kHz->line rate; reports gross-error, arcmin accuracy, persistence/run-length by velocity; 3-panel figure
Writes results/rate_sweep_verdict.md: whether persistence collapses above ~820Hz and whether a high-rate window achieves sub-0.1 deg; STOP-and-report if it fails with perfect labels+physics

OUTCOME (honest, data-supported): VERDICT = case (ii) VIABLE FOR FIXATION/PURSUIT, SACCADE-LIMITED. (a) Persistence (gross-run-length IN TIME) COLLAPSES across the 826Hz gate as predicted: worst run 500ms@60Hz -> 15.9ms@820 -> 10ms@1500 -> 1.7ms@12kHz. (b) High-rate sub-0.1deg window EXISTS for fixation/pursuit (RMS 0.86' @12kHz, sub-0.1deg at >=1500Hz, lockFix 1.00) but NOT for saccade (best 35.9', blur-limited at every rate). Runs with PERFECT labels+physics (atlas that made the stream IS the decoder), so the passive physics score is the MEASURED bottleneck during the blurred saccade fast-phase -> G14 (learned/coupled likelihood) indicated. NOT dead (case iii): fixation/pursuit is solved. rate_sweep.py (cached per rate+seed), 3-panel results/rate_sweep.png, results/rate_sweep_verdict.md, tests/test_rate_sweep.py (10/10; suite 98/98). Test validates the HARNESS + verdict structure, not a fudged saccade outcome.

stories.title: Self-supervised losses (+ optional learned likelihood)
acceptanceCriteria: losses.py + train.py: L_recon, L_dyn (off-manifold/main-seq/band-limit), L_couple, optional L_anchor; learned likelihood only if G13 shows physics-score bottleneck
training stable, does not degrade G13 synthetic accuracy; report whether learned likelihood reduces residual gross at operating rate

OUTCOME (honest, data-supported): G13 condition MET (physics IS the saccade bottleneck) so the learned likelihood IS implemented. losses.py has all four losses (each finite+differentiable, grad flows to the GAZE/head NOT the frozen decoder: L_recon~0@truth rises off; L_dyn penalizes >VMAX via dynamics.VMAX_ROWS_S + band-limit; L_couple penalizes bent saccades & skips pure-perp; L_anchor matches slow comp). LEARNED LIKELIHOOD (LearnedPerpLikelihood, small MLP) is BLUR-AWARE: motion blur kills the FINE band (true-row fine-NCC 0.97->0.23 fixation->saccade) but the COARSE band SURVIVES (0.97 during saccade), so features = fine/mid/coarse NCC + blur cue + interactions; decoder FROZEN (features detached). train.py trains by NLL of true perp on cached labeled-synthetic candidate grids, saccade lines upweighted; --report writes results/g14_report.md + cache/g14_head.pt. RESULT = PARTIAL YES: on 4 DISJOINT held-out seed groups the learned likelihood REDUCES saccade gross (e.g. 0.222->0.049, RMS 78.5r->22.6r on val 6-9; consistent on 8,9 / 10-13 / 14-17) and NEVER degrades fixation (gross 0.000, RMS ~0.25r=0.012deg, sub-0.1deg ALWAYS preserved), but blur stays a HARD physics limit (saccade RMS still above 0.1deg everywhere). Training STABLE (loss 5.77->0.91 monotone, no NaN). Integrated into filter.run(...,likelihood='physics'|'learned') with 'physics' default (no regression); both modes preserve G10 fixation sub-0.1deg. tests/test_losses.py (12) + tests/test_train.py (5); FULL suite 113/113 (was 98, +15, zero regressions). Tests assert the fixation invariant + grad-not-to-decoder + measure/PRINT the saccade delta honestly (no faked positive).

stories.title: Real-data deployment + validation (GATE 2)
acceptanceCriteria: Deploy filter self-supervised on real x-scan stream (recon+dyn+couple, no traj labels); eval_real.py validates via slow-vs-frame-truth, oculomotor statistics, alias-collapse-with-rate
results/real_validation.md reports the three checks with numbers; flags whether real matches synthetic prediction; notes self-consistency necessary not sufficient

OUTCOME (honest GATE 2): eval_real.py deploys filter.run self-supervised on real test2 x-scan (global-mean de-banded; along=data.along_shift, anchor=data.coarse_perp; NO labels). (a) slow-vs-machine-tracker |r| perp 0.62 / along 0.69 (OFF 2.3s; tracker is the frame-rate-truth surrogate — test2 has no co-registered raster). (b) drift PSD slope -1.73 (matches ~-2 oculomotor); main-seq slope & microsaccade rate COLLAPSE under the 15Hz low-pass + cross-scale reseed noise (honestly flagged as divergence). (c) persistence COLLAPSES with rate 102ms@342Hz -> 25ms@2kHz (MATCHES synthetic G13). VERDICT: PARTIAL MATCH, cross-scale-limited (normal/ atlas vs test2 x-scan, fine-NCC median ~0.2). results/real_validation.md states all three checks + the cross-scale caveat + the explicit 'self-consistency necessary not sufficient' (PLAN #3). tests/test_eval_real.py (7) assert the harness+finite numbers+report, not a fudged positive. Full suite 120/120.
